metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 256 Hz using 61 active electrodes in a 10-5 montage (g.tec g.GAMMAsys/g.LADYbird cap) with reference at left earlobe and ground at AFF2h. Participants performed five motor imagery/attempted movement tasks cued visually for 3 seconds followed by 3-second imagery periods. Preprocessing included 0.01-100 Hz bandpass filtering, 50 Hz notch filtering, ICA-based artifact removal, and trial rejection for amplitude (±100 μV), abnormal joint probability, or kurtosis outliers. Final analysis used 0.3-3 Hz bandpass filtering with common average re-referencing.

citation_details.abstract: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCI) is an exciting and emerging research area for researchers and scientists. This article also covers how current results can contribute to new knowledge about BCI, an overview of BCI from its early developments to recent advancements, BCI applications, challenges, and future directions.
